description: Public Service Commission - The Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technical Education Service - First Amendment
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Technical Education Service, specifically detailing recruitment procedures, examination processes, qualification requirements, and training programs for public service positions (Instructors and Lecturers). It is issued by the Public Service Commission and deals with public sector recruitment and service conditions, which falls under Public Service Gazettes.
